blocks.title: File handling
blocks.text: File handling ka matlab files se parhna aur un mein likhna hai; yeh data ko program khatam hone ke baad tak mustaqil rakhne ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Programs ko file handling kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Program khatam hone par variables khatam ho jate hain; files data rakhti hain ta ke baad mein dobara istemal ho.

items: File handling: data mustaqil rakhne ke liye files parhna aur likhna.
